subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian festivals celebrates the death of the demon king Ravana at the hands of Lord Rama?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dussehra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• The **tenth day **after Sharad Navratri is celebrated as **Dussehra or Vijayadashami.**
 
• **Navratri ("nine nights")** also called **Durga Puja**, in Hinduism, is a **major festival** held in **honor of the divine feminine.**
 
• Navratri occurs over 9 days during the month of Ash
